assessment_objectives.objective: the third-party relationships for which a documented exit strategy is required are identified based on criticality, dependency and risk.
a documented exit strategy exists for applicable third-party relationships before the cessation of third-party services.
each exit strategy addresses an orderly, secure, compliant and resilient transition to another third-party or to internally-managed services.
exit strategies are reviewed and updated at a defined frequency and upon significant change to the third-party relationship or the services provided.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change to the third-party relationship or the services provided

assessment_objectives.objective: upon cessation of third-party services, the documented exit strategy is executed.
